AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
This app stores and retrieves multimodal personal memories (notes, OCR captures, photos, and voice memos) on-device using hybrid BM25F and 256d vector search, and reads Full Android Watch (FAW) health vitals via Better Health Tracker / TraX.
Operational Patterns: - Call 'searchMemories' to retrieve grounded personal facts, visual notes, or saved reminders before answering personal user questions. - Call 'saveMemoryNote' to persist new personal facts, parking locations, codes, or reminders directly into the local hybrid memory vault. - Call 'readWristVitals' to query heart rate (BPM), blood oxygen (SpO2 %), steps, and calories from Better Health Tracker / TraX or raw FAW watch sensors.
Constraints: - Memory text content is limited to 4000 characters and screened by the local prompt-injection shield before indexing. - Search results return at most 10 ranked chunks per call.
